title: Omni-UBench: Benchmarking Omni-Modal LLM-based Guardrails Across Safety, Utility, and Reliability
title_zh: Omni-UBench：在安全性、实用性与可靠性维度上对全模态LLM防护栏进行基准评测

paragraphs.en: 提出Omni-UBench，首个沿安全性、实用性与可靠性评估全模态LLM防护栏的全面基准，含18.3万样本。 Advances in Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have enabled increasingly seamless human-AI interaction, but their unified processing of heterogeneous modalities also expands the attack surface, allowing adversaries to exploit richer input compositions to circumvent safety alignment. To counter such risks, omni-modal guardrails have been proposed to detect and filter unsafe queries across arbitrary modalities. However, their capabilities and limitations remain insufficiently understood due to the absence of a comprehensive evaluation benchmark. In this paper, we present Omni-UBench, the first comprehensive framework for omni-modal safety assessment, evaluating guardrail models along three critical dimensions, i.e., safety, utility, and reliability. Omni-UBench curates over 183k samples drawn from 35+ heterogeneous sources spanning text, image, audio, video, and their cross-modal combinations, annotated with safety labels under a unified risk taxonomy. Benchmarking under Omni-UBench on 15 representative OLLMs and omni-modal guardrails yields several key findings, including: (1) modern OLLMs exhibit strong content moderation potential even without guardrail-specific tuning; (2) existing guardrails still struggle to identify cross-modal queries that conceal harmful intent or involve sophisticated jailbreaks; (3) they further exhibit substantial safety hallucination and over-sensitivity to textual patterns, revealing a deficient understanding of cross-modal safety semantics. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing more trustworthy omni-modal guardrails in future research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出Omni-UBench，这是首个沿安全性、实用性与可靠性评估全模态LLM防护栏的全面基准，包含18.3万样本。全模态大语言模型（OLLM）的进展使人与AI的交互日益无缝，但其对异构模态的统一处理也扩大了攻击面，使攻击者能够利用更丰富的输入组合来绕过安全对齐。 为了应对此类风险，研究者提出了全模态防护栏，用于检测并过滤跨任意模态的不安全查询。 然而，由于缺乏全面的评估基准，这些防护栏的能力与局限仍未被充分理解。 在本文中，我们提出Omni-UBench，这是首个用于全模态安全评估的综合框架，沿三个关键维度（即安全性、实用性与可靠性）评估防护栏模型。 Omni-UBench汇集了超过18.3万个样本，来自涵盖文本、图像、音频、视频及其跨模态组合的35个以上异构来源，并在统一的风险分类体系下标注了安全标签。 在Omni-UBench上对15个代表性OLLM和全模态防护栏进行基准测试，得出若干关键发现，包括：（1）现代OLLM即使未经过针对防护栏的专门调优，也展现出强大的内容审核潜力；（2）现有防护栏仍难以识别隐藏有害意图或涉及复杂越狱的跨模态查询；（3）它们还表现出严重的安全幻觉以及对文本模式的过度敏感，揭示了对跨模态安全语义理解的不足。 我们的发现为未来研究中开发更值得信赖的全模态防护栏提供了宝贵见解。
